Schema mapping failure.root_cause: Field key casing and label variation between vision extraction and ground-truth key definitions.

Validation failure.root_cause: Printed document total differs from subtotal sum. System correctly flags arithmetic error and routes job to WaitingForReview.

Hallucination / Extra field extraction.root_cause: Extracted transient metadata fields (e.g. serNo, lineItems) not specified in flat ground-truth schema.
